name: Exactly What You Came Here For
source:
Sarah feels her life is over. She is unable to live for herself, but perhaps she can live for another. She takes the only option she can think of, and with nothing left to lose, learns exactly how much can still be taken from her.

[From [url=https://adazzle.itch.io/exactly-what-you-came-here-for]itch.io[/url]]
